One pinned run of CodegenCompileWaitBenchmark on the quiet laptop, after task 233's unpinned run
(CodegenCompileWaitBenchmark-jdk25-laptop-results.txt, which the post quotes) and to check it: one
benchmark at a time, pinned to the fast cores as dev/varka_bench_regen.sh pins them (taskset -c
0-3,12-15, the four Zen 5 cores at 5.16 GHz and their SMT siblings). Under the pin the JVM sees 8
processors and starts 4 C2 compiler threads and 8 parallel GC threads, against 12 and 18 unpinned.
Each run is reproduced as the benchmark printed it (PLAN_TASK_233.md 17).
